reason: The free one-pager is fine, it does not cost me anything and I might read it in the truck between jobs. But I paid an agency over a grand a month for a year for click reports and got almost no work out of it, so a stranger in Roscoe telling me he will fix my follow-up for $950 sounds like the same movie with a smaller ticket.
objection: Anyone can promise a written test up front. What burned me last time was not the pitch, it was that nobody could show me the money afterward, so how do I know his test is not just a nicer-sounding version of a clicks report?
would_change_my_mind: A five-minute call with one other owner in the area, a plumber or another one-truck guy I could actually call, who says the missed-call fix put real booked jobs on his calendar, plus a test written in jobs and dollars, not deliverables, so I can tell if it failed.
